garbled_sections.method: No clean automated count exists for this corpus (ordinary extracted text also carries control characters from PDF extraction, so character-class detectors over-count). Hard evidence: 21 sections literally begin with the PK zip signature (unextracted EPUB files); writer inspection during the run flagged about 53 sections of the same class (medicare.gov booklets, ssa.gov and choosework.ssa.gov pages); spot checks of flagged sections confirmed raw EPUB/PDF binary end to end. Pre-existing corpus defect: the stored text itself is binary, so these sections carry title-level topic questions, the best enrichment possible without re-extracting the source files.
